sentences.text: This massive marine reptile reached a total body length exceeding 15 meters.
The species Himalayasaurus tibetensis was formally described in 1972 based on fragmentary fossils including teeth, limb bones, and vertebrae.

Himalayasaurus is classified within the superorder Ichthyopterygia and the order Ichthyosauria, belonging to the family Shastasauridae which contains other large Triassic ichthyosaurs such as Shonisaurus.
This extinct ichthyosaur lived during the Norian stage of the Late Triassic, between 215.38 and 211.18 million years ago, in the Qulonggongba Formation of Tibet.
Himalayasaurus is often considered a nomen dubium due to a lack of distinguishing features, though distinct cutting edges on its teeth have been proposed as a unique trait.
